# RL training run diagnosis

Review the staged post-training experiment and determine whether it is healthy
or unhealthy. Treat the workspace as a historical snapshot: inspect its source,
effective configuration, launch scripts, data processing, reward logic, logs,
tracked metrics, and frozen evaluation evidence. Do not assume that an unusual
setting or implementation is causal without connecting it to observed behavior.

Use held-out evaluation evidence together with rollout, truncation, runtime,
optimization, and training signals. Training reward alone does not establish
held-out health. A truncated log is not by itself proof of a defect.

Do not launch a full training run, use the network, or modify the historical
snapshot. The dataset, held-out set, model, training-step budget, and evaluation
interval are fixed.

## Deliverable

Write one concise UTF-8 diagnosis to:

```text
$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/agent_answer.md
```

State the verdict, identify the concrete root cause or causes, and explain the
causal chain using specific workspace evidence. Distinguish root causes from
symptoms. Do not propose or implement a fix, and do not write other deliverable
files.
I’ll inspect the experiment’s configuration, implementation, logs, and frozen evaluation evidence, then trace any abnormal evaluation behavior back to a concrete cause.

1	#!/bin/bash
2	# GRPO (verl FSDP + vLLM) on Countdown.
3	# Builds the RL parquet with scripts/data_prep_countdown.py, then trains.
4	# Env vars configure the run; extra Hydra overrides on the command line are appended last.
5	set -euo pipefail
6	WS="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
7	export WS
8	
9	MODEL=${MODEL:-$WS/models/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct} # a small instruct model that follows the <answer> format on Countdown
10	NGPU=${NGPU:-2}
11	EXP=${EXP:-grpo}
12	RESP=${RESP:-1024}
13	BS=${BS:-64}
14	MINI=${MINI:-32}
15	N=${N:-8}
16	LR=${LR:-2e-6}
17	STEPS=${STEPS:-50}
18	GPU_UTIL=${GPU_UTIL:-0.35}
19	SEED=${SEED:-1}
20	QUANT=${QUANT-fp8}         # rollout weight quantization; empty = off
21	KV_DTYPE=${KV_DTYPE:-auto} # rollout KV-cache dtype; fp8 = on
22	RAW_DATA=${RAW_DATA:-$WS/raw/countdown}
23	DATA_DIR=${DATA_DIR:-$WS/data/countdown}
24	MAXTOK=$(( RESP + 512 ))
25	LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-$WS/outputs/$EXP}
26	mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
27	export PYTHONPATH="$WS/verl${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
28	export WANDB_MODE=${WANDB_MODE:-offline} WANDB_DIR="$LOG_DIR" WANDB_DISABLE_CODE=true
29	export RAY_DEDUP_LOGS=0 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
30	export VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH=${VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH:-$LOG_DIR/metrics.jsonl}
31	
32	if [ ! -f "$DATA_DIR/train.parquet" ]; then
33	    test -d "$RAW_DATA" || { echo "countdown snapshot missing: $RAW_DATA (fetch Jiayi-Pan/Countdown-Tasks-3to4 first)"; exit 1; }
34	    python3 "$WS/scripts/data_prep_countdown.py" --src "$RAW_DATA" --out "$DATA_DIR" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/data_prep.log"
35	fi
36	
37	ARGS=(
38	    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo
39	    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False
40	    data.train_files="$DATA_DIR/train.parquet"
41	    data.val_files="$DATA_DIR/test.parquet"
42	    data.train_batch_size=$BS
43	    data.max_prompt_length=256
44	    data.max_response_length=$RESP
45	    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True
46	    data.truncation=error
47	    data.shuffle=True
48	    data.seed=$SEED
49	    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$MODEL"
50	    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True
51	    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True
52	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=$LR
53	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.weight_decay=0.0
54	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=$MINI
55	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True
56	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=$MAXTOK
57	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False
58	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0
59	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0
60	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=token-mean
61	    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=$MAXTOK
62	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm
63	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1
64	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=$GPU_UTIL
65	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=$N
66	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len=$MAXTOK
67	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0
68	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_p=1.0
69	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=$MAXTOK
70	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.num_workers=8
71	    # keep the rollout engine resident across training steps (stable memory
72	    # profile; the vLLM sleep/wake cycle is not exercised)
73	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.free_cache_engine=False
74	    # ship the whole model in a single weight-sync bucket so per-layer fused
75	    # (q/k/v, gate/up) tensors never straddle a bucket boundary
76	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.checkpoint_engine.update_weights_bucket_megabytes=16384
77	    reward.custom_reward_function.path="$WS/scripts/countdown_reward.py"
78	    reward.custom_reward_function.name=compute_score
79	    trainer.logger='["console","file","wandb"]'
80	    trainer.project_name=countdown_grpo
81	    trainer.experiment_name="$EXP"
82	    trainer.default_local_dir="$LOG_DIR/checkpoints"
83	    trainer.rollout_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/rollouts"
84	    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=$NGPU
85	    trainer.nnodes=1
86	    trainer.save_freq=-1
87	    trainer.test_freq=-1
88	    trainer.val_before_train=False
89	    trainer.total_training_steps=$STEPS
90	    trainer.total_epochs=10
91	)
92	if [ -n "$QUANT" ]; then
93	    ARGS+=(actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization="$QUANT")
94	fi
95	if [ "$KV_DTYPE" != "auto" ]; then
96	    ARGS+=("+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.kv_cache_dtype=$KV_DTYPE")
97	fi
98	
99	python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo "${ARGS[@]}" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/train.log"
100

#!/bin/bash
# GRPO (verl FSDP + vLLM) on Countdown.
# Builds the RL parquet with scripts/data_prep_countdown.py, then trains.
# Env vars configure the run; extra Hydra overrides on the command line are appended last.
set -euo pipefail
WS="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
export WS

MODEL=${MODEL:-$WS/models/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct} # a small instruct model that follows the <answer> format on Countdown
NGPU=${NGPU:-2}
EXP=${EXP:-grpo}
RESP=${RESP:-1024}
BS=${BS:-64}
MINI=${MINI:-32}
N=${N:-8}
LR=${LR:-2e-6}
STEPS=${STEPS:-50}
GPU_UTIL=${GPU_UTIL:-0.35}
SEED=${SEED:-1}
QUANT=${QUANT-fp8}         # rollout weight quantization; empty = off
KV_DTYPE=${KV_DTYPE:-auto} # rollout KV-cache dtype; fp8 = on
RAW_DATA=${RAW_DATA:-$WS/raw/countdown}
DATA_DIR=${DATA_DIR:-$WS/data/countdown}
MAXTOK=$(( RESP + 512 ))
LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-$WS/outputs/$EXP}
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
export PYTHONPATH="$WS/verl${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
export WANDB_MODE=${WANDB_MODE:-offline} WANDB_DIR="$LOG_DIR" WANDB_DISABLE_CODE=true
export RAY_DEDUP_LOGS=0 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH=${VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH:-$LOG_DIR/metrics.jsonl}

if [ ! -f "$DATA_DIR/train.parquet" ]; then
    test -d "$RAW_DATA" || { echo "countdown snapshot missing: $RAW_DATA (fetch Jiayi-Pan/Countdown-Tasks-3to4 first)"; exit 1; }
    python3 "$WS/scripts/data_prep_countdown.py" --src "$RAW_DATA" --out "$DATA_DIR" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/data_prep.log"
fi

ARGS=(
    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo
    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False
    data.train_files="$DATA_DIR/train.parquet"
    data.val_files="$DATA_DIR/test.parquet"
    data.train_batch_size=$BS
    data.max_prompt_length=256
    data.max_response_length=$RESP
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True
    data.truncation=error
    data.shuffle=True
    data.seed=$SEED
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$MODEL"
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=$LR
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.weight_decay=0.0
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=$MINI
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=$MAXTOK
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=token-mean
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=$MAXTOK
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=$GPU_UTIL
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=$N
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len=$MAXTOK
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_p=1.0
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=$MAXTOK
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.agent.num_workers=8
    # keep the rollout engine resident across training steps (stable memory
    # profile; the vLLM sleep/wake cycle is not exercised)
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.free_cache_engine=False
    # ship the whole model in a single weight-sync bucket so per-layer fused
    # (q/k/v, gate/up) tensors never straddle a bucket boundary
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.checkpoint_engine.update_weights_bucket_megabytes=16384
    reward.custom_reward_function.path="$WS/scripts/countdown_reward.py"
    reward.custom_reward_function.name=compute_score
    trainer.logger='["console","file","wandb"]'
    trainer.project_name=countdown_grpo
    trainer.experiment_name="$EXP"
    trainer.default_local_dir="$LOG_DIR/checkpoints"
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/rollouts"
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=$NGPU
    trainer.nnodes=1
    trainer.save_freq=-1
    trainer.test_freq=-1
    trainer.val_before_train=False
    trainer.total_training_steps=$STEPS
    trainer.total_epochs=10
)
if [ -n "$QUANT" ]; then
    ARGS+=(actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization="$QUANT")
fi
if [ "$KV_DTYPE" != "auto" ]; then
    ARGS+=("+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.kv_cache_dtype=$KV_DTYPE")
fi

python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo "${ARGS[@]}" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/train.log"

"""Convert Jiayi-Pan/Countdown-Tasks-3to4 into veRL RL parquet files."""
import argparse
import json
import os

import datasets
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

TRAIN_ROWS = 32768
TEST_ROWS = 1024

PROMPT_TEMPLATE = (
    "Using the numbers {nums}, create an equation that equals {target}. "
    "You can use basic arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /) and parentheses, "
    "and each number must be used once. Show your reasoning and output the "
    "final expression (without '= {target}') inside <answer>...</answer> tags, "
    "for example <answer>(1 + 2) * 3</answer>."
)


def build_split(targets: list, nums_list: list, indices: list[int], split: str) -> datasets.Dataset:
    rows = []
    for idx in indices:
        target = int(targets[idx])
        numbers = [int(x) for x in nums_list[idx]]
        content = PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(nums=numbers, target=target)
        rows.append(
            {
                "data_source": "Jiayi-Pan/Countdown-Tasks-3to4",
                "prompt": [{"role": "user", "content": content}],
                "ability": "math",
                "reward_model": {
                    "style": "rule",
                    "ground_truth": json.dumps({"numbers": numbers, "target": target}, sort_keys=True),
                },
                "extra_info": {
                    "split": split,
                    "index": idx,
                    "target": target,
                    "numbers": json.dumps(numbers),
                },
            }
        )
    return datasets.Dataset.from_list(rows)


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--src", required=True, help="Jiayi-Pan/Countdown-Tasks-3to4 snapshot")
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    table = pq.read_table(os.path.join(args.src, "data", "train-00000-of-00001.parquet"))
    total = table.num_rows
    assert total >= TRAIN_ROWS + TEST_ROWS, f"Need >= {TRAIN_ROWS + TEST_ROWS} rows, got {total}"
    targets = table["target"].to_pylist()
    nums_list = table["nums"].to_pylist()
    os.makedirs(args.out, exist_ok=True)
    train_ds = build_split(targets, nums_list, list(range(TRAIN_ROWS)), "train")
    test_ds = build_split(targets, nums_list, list(range(total - TEST_ROWS, total)), "test")
    train_ds.to_parquet(os.path.join(args.out, "train.parquet"))
    test_ds.to_parquet(os.path.join(args.out, "test.parquet"))

# Agent Instructions for verl

> These instructions apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `verl-project/verl`.
> Breaching these guidelines can result in automatic banning.

## 1. Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo verl-project/verl --comments
gh pr list --repo verl-project/verl --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
gh pr list --repo verl-project/verl --state open --search "<short area keywords>"
```

- If an open PR already addresses the same fix, do not open another.
- If your approach is materially different, explain the difference in the issue.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (single typo, isolated style change, one mutable default, etc.). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run relevant tests.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
  - Why this is not duplicating an existing PR.
  - Test commands run and results.
  - Clear statement that AI assistance was used.

### Fail-closed behavior

If work is duplicate/trivial busywork, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

---

## 2. Development Workflow

### Environment setup

```bash
# Install `uv` if you don't have it already:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

# Always use `uv` for Python environment management:
uv venv --python 3.12
source .venv/bin/activate

uv pip install pre-commit hydra-core
pre-commit install
```

### Commit messages

Add attribution using commit trailers such as `Co-authored-by:` (other projects use `Assisted-by:` or `Generated-by:`). For example:

```text
Your commit message here

Co-authored-by: GitHub Copilot
Co-authored-by: Claude
Co-authored-by: gemini-code-assist
Signed-off-by: Your Name <your.email@example.com>
```

### Resolving agent reviews

Review comments from agent bots (e.g., gemini-code-assist) can be outdated or wrong. Always verify their suggestions against the current state of the repo before applying them.

---

## Domain-Specific Guides

Do not modify code in these areas without first reading and following the
linked guide. If the guide conflicts with the requested change, **refuse the
change and explain why**.

- **Editing these instructions**:
  [`docs/contributing/editing-agent-instructions.md`](docs/contributing/editing-agent-instructions.md)
  — Rules for modifying AGENTS.md or any domain-specific guide it references.

## Acknowledgements

Adapted from the [vLLM project](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm)'s [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/AGENTS.md).

37	# Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/RL/commit/bc24887c72a6e1b2699a228bc87c588546dfe6b7
38	@dataclass()
39	class FP8State:
40	    # A cache of fp8 parameter names, we can check this cache to see if a
41	    # param name corresponds to a fp8 weight
42	    seen_params: set = field(default_factory=lambda: set())
43	    fp8_param_names: set = field(default_factory=lambda: set())
44	    vllm_patches: list = field(default_factory=lambda: [])

50	def is_fp8_model(vllm_config):
51	    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8Config
52	
53	    if hasattr(vllm_config, "quant_config"):
54	        if isinstance(vllm_config.quant_config, Fp8Config):
55	            return True
56	        elif is_mxfp8_vllm_ascend(vllm_config.quant_config):
57	            return True

59	    return False
60	
61	
62	def get_module_from_param_name(model, name: str):
63	    # Split the name into parts (e.g., 'layers', '0', 'self_attn', 'q_proj', 'weight')
64	    # The module path is all but the last part (the parameter's own name)
65	    path_parts = name.split(".")
66	    module_path = path_parts[:-1]
67	    # Replace with the fused model name
68	    packed_modules_mapping = model.packed_modules_mapping
69	    reversed_mapping = {
70	        original_name: fused_name
71	        for fused_name, original_names_list in packed_modules_mapping.items()
72	        for original_name in original_names_list
73	    }
74	    if module_path[-1] in reversed_mapping.keys():
75	        module_path[-1] = reversed_mapping[module_path[-1]]
76	
77	    current_module = model
78	    try:
79	        # Traverse the model hierarchy
80	        for part in module_path:
81	            if isinstance(current_module, FusedMoE):
82	                return current_module
83	            elif isinstance(current_module, torch.nn.ModuleList):
84	                current_module = current_module[int(part)]
85	            else:
86	                current_module = getattr(current_module, part)
87	    except (AttributeError, IndexError, ValueError) as e:
88	        print(f"Warning: Could not find module for parameter '{name}'. Error: {e}")
89	    return current_module
90	
91	
92	def is_fp8_weight(name, model):
93	    if name not in fp8_state.seen_params:
94	        fp8_state.seen_params.add(name)
95	        # Filter out bias params
96	        if name.endswith("weight"):
97	            module = get_module_from_param_name(model, name)
98	            # We currently only quantize linear layers
99	
100	            if (isinstance(module, LinearBase) and module.weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn) or (
101	                isinstance(module, FusedMoE)
102	                and module.w13_weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
103	                and module.w2_weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
104	            ):
105	                fp8_state.fp8_param_names.add(name)
106	    return name in fp8_state.fp8_param_names
107	
108	
109	def is_mxfp8_vllm_ascend(quant_config):
110	    try:
111	        from vllm_ascend.quantization.modelslim_config import AscendModelSlimConfig
112	        from vllm_ascend.quantization.quant_config import AscendQuantConfig
113	
114	        if isinstance(quant_config, AscendModelSlimConfig) or isinstance(quant_config, AscendQuantConfig):
115	            quant_method = quant_config.quant_description.get("quant_method")
116	            return quant_method in ["ascend"]
117	        return False
118	    except ImportError:
119	        # vllm_ascend not installed, so this can't be an Ascend MXFP8 config
120	        return False
121	
122	
123	def restore_mxfp8_weights_for_loading(model):
124	    for name, module in model.named_modules():
125	        if (
126	            hasattr(module, "_mxfp8_transformed")
127	            and hasattr(module, "quant_method")
128	            and hasattr(module.quant_method, "quant_method")
129	            and hasattr(module.quant_method.quant_method, "restore_weights_for_rl_loading")
130	        ):
131	            module.quant_method.quant_method.restore_weights_for_rl_loading(module)
132	
133	
134	def apply_mxfp8_transformation_after_loading(model):
135	    """Re-apply MXFP8 transformations after weight loading.
136	
137	    This function iterates through all linear modules in the model and applies
138	    the MXFP8 transformations (transpose, reshape) that are required for NPU
139	    inference.
140	
141	    Must be called AFTER model.load_weights() in RL training loops.
142	    """
143	    try:
144	        from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import LinearBase
145	    except ImportError:
146	        logger.warning("Could not import LinearBase, skipping MXFP8 transformation")
147	        return
148	
149	    for name, module in model.named_modules():
150	        if (isinstance(module, LinearBase) or isinstance(module, FusedMoE)) and hasattr(
151	            module, "_mxfp8_original_shapes"
152	        ):
153	            if hasattr(module, "quant_method") and hasattr(module.quant_method, "process_weights_after_loading"):
154	                logger.debug(f"Applying MXFP8 transformation for module: {name}")
155	                module.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(module)
156	
157	
158	def _fuse_stacked_weights(weights):
159	    """Interleave HF q/k/v and gate/up tensors into vLLM's fused qkv_proj /
160	    gate_up_proj order before blockwise quantization.
161	
162	    The synced weights come in HF format (separate q/k/v, gate/up), but vLLM's
163	    Qwen-style models hold fused parameters. Quantizing the shards separately
164	    produces per-shard scales that no longer tile the fused parameter (e.g. a
165	    q_proj scale [16, 16] vs the qkv_proj scale [32, 16]) and load_weights
166	    asserts. Tensors that are not part of a stack pass through unchanged.
167	    """
168	    qkv = ("q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj")
169	    stacked = (*qkv, "gate_proj", "up_proj")
170	    groups: dict = {}
171	    out: list = []
172	    for name, tensor in weights:
173	        fused_name = None
174	        for src in stacked:
175	            if f".{src}." in name:
176	                fused = ".qkv_proj." if src in qkv else ".gate_up_proj."
177	                fused_name = name.replace(f".{src}.", fused)
178	                groups.setdefault(fused_name, {})[src] = (name, tensor)
179	                break
180	        if fused_name is None:
181	            out.append((name, tensor))
182	    for fused_name, shards in groups.items():
183	        order = qkv if "qkv_proj." in fused_name else ("gate_proj", "up_proj")
184	        if all(s in shards for s in order):
185	            out.append((fused_name, torch.cat([shards[s][1] for s in order], dim=0)))
186	        else:  # unexpected partial group: keep the originals
187	            for _, (name, tensor) in shards.items():
188	                out.append((name, tensor))
189	    return out
190	
191	
192	def quant_weights(weights, model, quant_config, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
193	    """Quantize weights to FP8 format using a memory-efficient generator.
194	
195	
196	    Args:
197	        weights: Generator or iterable of (name, tensor) pairs
198	        model: The model to check for FP8 weight names
199	        quant_config: Quantization configuration with weight_block_size
200	        dtype: Data type for intermediate computation (default: bfloat16)
201	
202	    Yields:
203	        Tuples of (name, tensor) for each weight and its scale
204	    """
205	
206	    fp8_state.seen_params.clear()
207	    fp8_state.fp8_param_names.clear()
208	    weights = _fuse_stacked_weights(weights)
209	    is_mxfp8_npu = is_mxfp8_vllm_ascend(quant_config)
210	    if is_mxfp8_npu:
211	        import torch_npu
212	    # vLLM v0.11-v0.12 renamed weight_scale_inv → weight_scale in process_weights_after_loading,
213	    # so load_weights expects "_scale" suffix. v0.14+ keeps weight_scale_inv, so expects "_scale_inv".
214	    _use_scale_not_scale_inv = version.parse("0.11.0") <= version.parse(vllm.__version__) < version.parse("0.14.0")
215	
216	    for k, v in weights:
217	        if not is_fp8_weight(k, model):
218	            yield (k, v)
219	            continue
220	
221	        # Cast the weight into fp8 and its scale factor
222	        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
223	            logger.debug(f"Quantizing to FP8 blockwise: {k}")
224	        if is_mxfp8_npu:
225	            param_lp, param_scale = torch_npu.npu_dynamic_mx_quant(
226	                v.to(dtype),
227	                axis=-1,
228	                dst_type=torch_npu.float8_e4m3fn,
229	            )
230	            param_scale = param_scale.flatten(-2, -1)
231	        else:
232	            param_lp, param_scale = scaled_fp8_blockwise(
233	                v.to(dtype),
234	                weight_block_size=quant_config.weight_block_size,
235	            )
236	        param_scale = param_scale.squeeze(-1)
237	
238	        # Yield the quantized weight
239	        yield (k, param_lp)
240	
241	        # Yield the scale with appropriate naming based on vLLM version
242	        if is_mxfp8_npu:
243	            yield (k + "_scale", param_scale)
244	        elif _use_scale_not_scale_inv and "expert" not in k:
245	            yield (k + "_scale", param_scale)
246	        else:
247	            yield (k + "_scale_inv", param_scale)
248	
249	        # Explicitly delete original tensor reference to help GC
250	        del v, param_lp, param_scale
251	
252	
253	def load_quanted_weights(weights, model_runner, is_drafter=False):
254	    if is_drafter:
255	        drafter = getattr(model_runner, "drafter", None)
256	        model = drafter.model if drafter is not None and hasattr(drafter, "model") else None
257	        assert model is not None, (
258	            "load_quanted_weights(is_drafter=True) requires model_runner.drafter.model "
259	            "to be present and non-None for FP8 weight loading."
260	        )
261	    else:
262	        model = model_runner.model
263	    quant_config = model_runner.vllm_config.quant_config
264	    vllm_dtype = model_runner.vllm_config.model_config.dtype
265	
266	    is_mxfp8_npu = is_mxfp8_vllm_ascend(quant_config)
267

import inspect
import logging
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from unittest.mock import patch

import torch
import vllm
from packaging import version

try:
    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.layer import FusedMoE
    from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import LinearBase
except ImportError as e:
    raise ImportError("FP8 quantization not available") from e

from verl.utils.kernel.fp8_kernel import scaled_fp8_blockwise

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/RL/commit/bc24887c72a6e1b2699a228bc87c588546dfe6b7
@dataclass()
class FP8State:
    # A cache of fp8 parameter names, we can check this cache to see if a
    # param name corresponds to a fp8 weight
    seen_params: set = field(default_factory=lambda: set())
    fp8_param_names: set = field(default_factory=lambda: set())
    vllm_patches: list = field(default_factory=lambda: [])


fp8_state: FP8State = FP8State()


def is_fp8_model(vllm_config):
    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8Config

    if hasattr(vllm_config, "quant_config"):
        if isinstance(vllm_config.quant_config, Fp8Config):
            return True
        elif is_mxfp8_vllm_ascend(vllm_config.quant_config):
            return True

    return False


def get_module_from_param_name(model, name: str):
    # Split the name into parts (e.g., 'layers', '0', 'self_attn', 'q_proj', 'weight')
    # The module path is all but the last part (the parameter's own name)
    path_parts = name.split(".")
    module_path = path_parts[:-1]
    # Replace with the fused model name
    packed_modules_mapping = model.packed_modules_mapping
    reversed_mapping = {
        original_name: fused_name
        for fused_name, original_names_list in packed_modules_mapping.items()
        for original_name in original_names_list
    }
    if module_path[-1] in reversed_mapping.keys():
        module_path[-1] = reversed_mapping[module_path[-1]]

    current_module = model
    try:
        # Traverse the model hierarchy
        for part in module_path:
            if isinstance(current_module, FusedMoE):
                return current_module
            elif isinstance(current_module, torch.nn.ModuleList):
                current_module = current_module[int(part)]
            else:
                current_module = getattr(current_module, part)
    except (AttributeError, IndexError, ValueError) as e:
        print(f"Warning: Could not find module for parameter '{name}'. Error: {e}")
    return current_module


def is_fp8_weight(name, model):
    if name not in fp8_state.seen_params:
        fp8_state.seen_params.add(name)
        # Filter out bias params
        if name.endswith("weight"):
            module = get_module_from_param_name(model, name)
            # We currently only quantize linear layers

            if (isinstance(module, LinearBase) and module.weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn) or (
                isinstance(module, FusedMoE)
                and module.w13_weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
                and module.w2_weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
            ):
                fp8_state.fp8_param_names.add(name)
    return name in fp8_state.fp8_param_names


def is_mxfp8_vllm_ascend(quant_config):
    try:
        from vllm_ascend.quantization.modelslim_config import AscendModelSlimConfig
        from vllm_ascend.quantization.quant_config import AscendQuantConfig

        if isinstance(quant_config, AscendModelSlimConfig) or isinstance(quant_config, AscendQuantConfig):
            quant_method = quant_config.quant_description.get("quant_method")
            return quant_method in ["ascend"]
        return False
    except ImportError:
        # vllm_ascend not installed, so this can't be an Ascend MXFP8 config
        return False


def restore_mxfp8_weights_for_loading(model):
    for name, module in model.named_modules():
        if (
            hasattr(module, "_mxfp8_transformed")
            and hasattr(module, "quant_method")
            and hasattr(module.quant_method, "quant_method")
            and hasattr(module.quant_method.quant_method, "restore_weights_for_rl_loading")
        ):
            module.quant_method.quant_method.restore_weights_for_rl_loading(module)


def apply_mxfp8_transformation_after_loading(model):
    """Re-apply MXFP8 transformations after weight loading.

    This function iterates through all linear modules in the model and applies
    the MXFP8 transformations (transpose, reshape) that are required for NPU
    inference.

    Must be called AFTER model.load_weights() in RL training loops.
    """
    try:
        from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import LinearBase
    except ImportError:
        logger.warning("Could not import LinearBase, skipping MXFP8 transformation")
        return

    for name, module in model.named_modules():
        if (isinstance(module, LinearBase) or isinstance(module, FusedMoE)) and hasattr(
            module, "_mxfp8_original_shapes"
        ):
            if hasattr(module, "quant_method") and hasattr(module.quant_method, "process_weights_after_loading"):
                logger.debug(f"Applying MXFP8 transformation for module: {name}")
                module.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(module)


def _fuse_stacked_weights(weights):
    """Interleave HF q/k/v and gate/up tensors into vLLM's fused qkv_proj /
    gate_up_proj order before blockwise quantization.

    The synced weights come in HF format (separate q/k/v, gate/up), but vLLM's
    Qwen-style models hold fused parameters. Quantizing the shards separately
    produces per-shard scales that no longer tile the fused parameter (e.g. a
    q_proj scale [16, 16] vs the qkv_proj scale [32, 16]) and load_weights
    asserts. Tensors that are not part of a stack pass through unchanged.
    """
    qkv = ("q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj")
    stacked = (*qkv, "gate_proj", "up_proj")
    groups: dict = {}
    out: list = []
    for name, tensor in weights:
        fused_name = None
        for src in stacked:
            if f".{src}." in name:
                fused = ".qkv_proj." if src in qkv else ".gate_up_proj."
                fused_name = name.replace(f".{src}.", fused)
                groups.setdefault(fused_name, {})[src] = (name, tensor)
                break
        if fused_name is None:
            out.append((name, tensor))
    for fused_name, shards in groups.items():
        order = qkv if "qkv_proj." in fused_name else ("gate_proj", "up_proj")

            out.append((fused_name, torch.cat([shards[s][1] for s in order], dim=0)))
        else:  # unexpected partial group: keep the originals
            for _, (name, tensor) in shards.items():

def quant_weights(weights, model, quant_config, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
    """Quantize weights to FP8 format using a memory-efficient generator.


    Args:
        weights: Generator or iterable of (name, tensor) pairs
        model: The model to check for FP8 weight names
        quant_config: Quantization configuration with weight_block_size
        dtype: Data type for intermediate computation (default: bfloat16)

    Yields:
        Tuples of (name, tensor) for each weight and its scale
    """

    fp8_state.seen_params.clear()
    fp8_state.fp8_param_names.clear()
    weights = _fuse_stacked_weights(weights)
    is_mxfp8_npu = is_mxfp8_vllm_ascend(quant_config)
    if is_mxfp8_npu:
        import torch_npu
    # vLLM v0.11-v0.12 renamed weight_scale_inv → weight_scale in process_weights_after_loading,
    # so load_weights expects "_scale" suffix. v0.14+ keeps weight_scale_inv, so expects "_scale_inv".
    _use_scale_not_scale_inv = version.parse("0.11.0") <= version.parse(vllm.__version__) < version.parse("0.14.0")

    for k, v in weights:
        if not is_fp8_weight(k, model):
            yield (k, v)
            continue

        # Cast the weight into fp8 and its scale factor
        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            logger.debug(f"Quantizing to FP8 blockwise: {k}")
        if is_mxfp8_npu:
            param_lp, param_scale = torch_npu.npu_dynamic_mx_quant(
                v.to(dtype),
                axis=-1,
                dst_type=torch_npu.float8_e4m3fn,
            )
            param_scale = param_scale.flatten(-2, -1)
        else:
            param_lp, param_scale = scaled_fp8_blockwise(
                v.to(dtype),
                weight_block_size=quant_config.weight_block_size,
            )
        param_scale = param_scale.squeeze(-1)

        # Yield the quantized weight
        yield (k, param_lp)

        # Yield the scale with appropriate naming based on vLLM version
        if is_mxfp8_npu:
            yield (k + "_scale", param_scale)
        elif _use_scale_not_scale_inv and "expert" not in k:
            yield (k + "_scale", param_scale)
        else:
            yield (k + "_scale_inv", param_scale)

        # Explicitly delete original tensor reference to help GC
        del v, param_lp, param_scale


def load_quanted_weights(weights, model_runner, is_drafter=False):
    if is_drafter:
        drafter = getattr(model_runner, "drafter", None)
        model = drafter.model if drafter is not None and hasattr(drafter, "model") else None
        assert model is not None, (
            "load_quanted_weights(is_drafter=True) requires model_runner.drafter.model "
            "to be present and non-None for FP8 weight loading."
        )
    else:
        model = model_runner.model
    quant_config = model_runner.vllm_config.quant_config
    vllm_dtype = model_runner.vllm_config.model_config.dtype

    is_mxfp8_npu = is_mxfp8_vllm_ascend(quant_config)

    if is_mxfp8_npu:
        # For MXFP8 on NPU, we need to restore weights to original shapes
        # before loading, then re-apply transformation after loading.
        # This is because process_weights_after_loading transposes the weights,
        # but the weight_loader expects original shapes.
        restore_mxfp8_weights_for_loading(model)

    weights_quantized = quant_weights(weights, model, quant_config, dtype=vllm_dtype)

    if is_mxfp8_npu:
        # Monkey patch the param class to their subclass, as certain models
        # will check the param type to call the proper weightloader
        for name, param in model.named_parameters():
            if hasattr(param, "subclass_type"):
                param.orig_type = param.__class__
                param.__class__ = param.subclass_type
        loaded_params = model.load_weights(weights_quantized)
        for name, param in model.named_parameters():
            if hasattr(param, "subclass_type"):
                param.__class__ = param.orig_type
        # Re-apply MXFP8 transformations after weight loading
        apply_mxfp8_transformation_after_loading(model)
        return loaded_params

    # Copy the quantized tensors straight into the live parameters. Routing
    # them through model.load_weights re-enters the stacked-params mapping,
    # whose bare substring matching corrupts already-fused names (qkv_proj
    # contains v_proj -> qkqkv_proj) and sends blockwise scales to
    # default_weight_loader, which cannot place them into the fused (and on
    # SM90, transposed) scale parameters.
    params = dict(model.named_parameters())
    # The SM90 CUTLASS path stores blockwise weight scales transposed
    # (maybe_post_process_fp8_weight_block: weight_scale.T). Detect the live
    # convention from any non-square scale so square ones (o_proj) are not
    # silently mis-oriented.
    scales_transposed = False
    wbs = list(getattr(quant_config, "weight_block_size", (128, 128)))
    for name, p in params.items():
        if name.endswith((".weight_scale", ".weight_scale_inv")) and p.dim() == 2:
            base = name[: -len(".weight_scale")] if name.endswith(".weight_scale") else name[: -len(".weight_scale_inv")]
            w = params.get(base + ".weight")
            if w is not None and w.dim() == 2 and w.shape[0] != w.shape[1] and p.shape[0] != p.shape[1]:
                blocks = ((w.shape[0] + wbs[0] - 1) // wbs[0], (w.shape[1] + wbs[1] - 1) // wbs[1])
                scales_transposed = tuple(p.shape) == (blocks[1], blocks[0])
                break
    loaded_params = set()
    for name, tensor in weights_quantized:
        param = params.get(name)
        if param is None:
            logger.warning(f"FP8 reload: no parameter for {name}, skipping")
            continue
        if name.endswith((".weight_scale", ".weight_scale_inv")) and scales_transposed:
            tensor = tensor.T.contiguous()
        assert param.shape == tensor.shape, (
            f"FP8 reload: {name} parameter {tuple(param.shape)} != tensor {tuple(tensor.shape)}")
        param.data.copy_(tensor.to(param.dtype))
        loaded_params.add(name)
    return loaded_params


def _copy_param_subclass_attrs(param, source_param):
    if source_param is None:
        return

    base_param_dir = dir(torch.nn.Parameter)
    source_param_dir = dir(source_param)
    custom_attributes = [attr for attr in source_param_dir if attr not in base_param_dir and not attr.startswith("__")]
    for attr in custom_attributes:
        try:
            setattr(param, attr, getattr(source_param, attr))
        except AttributeError:
            pass

106	class vLLMColocateWorkerExtension:
107	    """
108	    The class for vLLM's worker to inherit from, in the colocate setting.
109	    By defining an extension class, the code can work no matter what is
110	    the underlying worker class. This way, the code can be compatible
111	    with both vLLM V0 and V1.
112	    NOTE: we define this class in a separate module, and the main module
113	    should pass the full qualified name as `worker_extension_cls` argument.
114	
115	    Feature support:
116	    1. LoRA
117	    2. Online FP8 quantization
118	    """
119	
120	    def __new__(cls, **kwargs):
121	        set_death_signal()
122	
123	        # 1. patch for Lora
124	        VLLMHijack.hijack()
125	        # 2. patch online fp8 quant
126	        if os.environ.get("VERL_VLLM_FP8_QUANT_ENABLED", "0") == "1":
127	            apply_vllm_fp8_patches()
128	        # 3. patch QAT (compressed-tensors NVFP4) for dynamic weight loading
129	        vllm_config = kwargs.get("vllm_config")
130	        quant_config = getattr(vllm_config, "quant_config", None) if vllm_config else None
131	        _is_qat_model = getattr(quant_config, "quant_format", None) == "nvfp4-pack-quantized"
132	        _is_modelopt_qat = type(quant_config).__name__ == "ModelOptNvFp4Config"
133	        if _is_qat_model:
134	            from verl.utils.qat import apply_qat_patches
135	
136	            apply_qat_patches()
137	            logger.info("Applied QAT (compressed-tensors) patches in vLLM worker subprocess")
138	        elif _is_modelopt_qat:
139	            from verl.utils.modelopt import apply_modelopt_nvfp4_patches
140	
141	            apply_modelopt_nvfp4_patches()
142	            logger.info("Applied ModelOpt NVFP4 patches in vLLM worker subprocess")
143	
144	        # TODO: For ascend NPU, when the corresponding vllm-ascend version is upgraded to v0.13.0,
145	        # please remove the VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS variable replacement action.
146	        # This is only a fix for vllm version < v0.13.0.
147	        if is_npu_available:
148	            for k in VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS:
149	                if k not in os.environ:
150	                    os.environ[k] = VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS[k]
151	
152	        instance = super().__new__(cls)
153	        instance._is_qat_model = _is_qat_model
154	        instance._is_modelopt_qat = _is_modelopt_qat
155	        return instance
156	
157	    def _get_drafter_model(self):
158	        """Return the drafter's model object, or None if unavailable."""
159	        drafter = getattr(self.model_runner, "drafter", None)
160	        return drafter.model if drafter is not None and hasattr(drafter, "model") else None
161	
162	    def _get_draft_model_config(self):
163	        """Return the draft model config from speculative_config, or None."""
164	        spec = self.model_runner.vllm_config.speculative_config
165	        return spec.draft_model_config if spec is not None and spec.draft_model_config is not None else None

167	    def _use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync(self):
168	        """Return whether the vLLM MTP drafter should receive actor weights."""
169	        spec = self.model_runner.vllm_config.speculative_config
170	        return spec is not None and spec.method == "mtp" and self._get_drafter_model() is not None

172	    def _iter_all_models(self):
173	        """Yield models that need weight updates.
174	
175	        Only vLLM MTP drafter sync is supported for now. Independent non-MTP
176	        draft models are not compatible with actor weight loading through this path.
177	        """
178	        yield self.model_runner.model
179	        if self._use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync():
180	            yield self._get_drafter_model()
181	
182	    def _iter_all_models_with_config(self):
183	        """Yield (model, model_config) for models that need post-processing."""
184	        yield self.model_runner.model, self.model_runner.vllm_config.model_config

188	                yield self._get_drafter_model(), draft_cfg

190	    def monkey_patch_model(self, vocab_size: int):
191	        for model in self._iter_all_models():
192	            # patch compute_logits to avoid sampling OOV token
193	            monkey_patch_compute_logits(model, vocab_size)

195	            patch_vllm_moe_model_weight_loader(model)

197	    def update_weights_from_ipc(self, peft_config: dict = None, base_sync_done=False, use_shm: bool = False):
198	        """Update the weights of the rollout model."""
199	        from vllm.platforms import current_platform
200	
201	        from verl.workers.rollout.vllm_rollout.bucketed_weight_transfer import BucketedWeightReceiver
202	
203	        if current_platform.device_type == "npu" and self.device is None:
204	            self.device = torch.device(f"npu:{self.local_rank}")
205	
206	        # In async mode, make sure the old lora is removed before adding the new one
207	        if peft_config and base_sync_done:
208	            self.remove_lora(VLLM_LORA_INT_ID)
209	
210	        use_standard_weight_load = not (peft_config and base_sync_done) and not is_fp8_model(
211	            self.model_runner.vllm_config
212	        )
213	
214	        if self._is_qat_model:
215	            # QAT (compressed-tensors): Prepare for weight loading BEFORE receiving any buckets
216	            from verl.utils.qat import prepare_qat_for_load_weights
217	
218	            for model in self._iter_all_models():
219	                prepare_qat_for_load_weights(model, device=self.device)
220	            logger.info("QAT: prepare_qat_for_load_weights completed")
221	        elif self._is_modelopt_qat:
222	            from verl.utils.modelopt.vllm_modelopt_patch import prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload
223	
224	            prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload(self.model_runner.model, device=self.device)
225	            logger.info("ModelOpt: prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload completed")
226	        elif use_standard_weight_load:
227	            # Re-apply here because async IPC weight sync can happen long after init and lose MoE weight_loader attrs.
228	            for model in self._iter_all_models():
229	                patch_vllm_moe_model_weight_loader(model)
230	
231	        assert self.device is not None
232	        receiver = BucketedWeightReceiver(
233	            zmq_handle=self._get_zmq_handle(),
234	            device=self.device,
235	            use_shm=use_shm,
236	        )
237	        receiver.receive_weights(
238	            on_bucket_received=lambda weights: self._update_weights(
239	                weights, peft_config=peft_config, base_sync_done=base_sync_done
240	            )
241	        )
242	
243	        if self._is_qat_model:
244	            # QAT (compressed-tensors): call process_weights_after_loading AFTER all buckets are received
245	            from verl.utils.qat import manual_process_weights_after_loading
246	
247	            for model in self._iter_all_models():
248	                manual_process_weights_after_loading(model)
249	            logger.info("QAT: process_weights_after_loading completed")
250	        elif self._is_modelopt_qat:
251	            from verl.utils.modelopt.vllm_modelopt_patch import modelopt_process_weights_after_loading
252	
253	            modelopt_process_weights_after_loading(self.model_runner.model)
254	            logger.info("ModelOpt QAT: process_weights_after_loading completed")
255	        elif use_standard_weight_load:
256	            # Some post-load transforms are non-idempotent; run once after all buckets.
257	            from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import process_weights_after_loading
258	
259	            for model, model_config in self._iter_all_models_with_config():
260	                process_weights_after_loading(model, model_config, self.device)
261	
262	    def _update_weights(self, weights: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]], peft_config: dict, base_sync_done: bool):
263	        if peft_config and base_sync_done:
264	            weights = dict(weights)
265	            lora_request = TensorLoRARequest(
266	                lora_name=VLLM_LORA_NAME,
267	                lora_int_id=VLLM_LORA_INT_ID,
268	                lora_path=VLLM_LORA_PATH,
269	                peft_config=peft_config,
270	                lora_tensors=weights,
271	            )
272	            self.add_lora(lora_request)
273	            logger.info(f"vLLM load weights, loaded_params: {len(weights)}")
274	        else:
275	            # Add the FP8 related logic here as sharding manager has been deprecated.
276	            # Check if FP8 quantization is enabled and apply appropriate weight loading
277	            if is_fp8_model(self.model_runner.vllm_config):
278	                logger.info(f"FP8 model detected (async): {self.model_runner.vllm_config.quant_config}")
279	                # Convert bf16 weights to fp8 format before loading
280	                loaded_params = load_quanted_weights(weights, self.model_runner)

291	        """Get ZMQ handle for communication.
292	        Uses Ray job id + replica_rank + local_rank to form the handle so it
293	        matches the sender side regardless of CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES differences,

295	        unique per Ray job to avoid cross-job collisions on shared hosts. The

301	        return f"ipc:///tmp/rl-colocate-zmq-{job_id}-replica-{replica_rank}-rank-{self.local_rank}.sock"

import ctypes
import json
import logging
import os
import platform
import signal
import threading
from types import MethodType
from typing import Any, Literal, Optional, get_args

import torch
from vllm.outputs import RequestOutput

from verl.utils.device import is_npu_available
from verl.utils.vllm import TensorLoRARequest, VLLMHijack
from verl.utils.vllm.patch import patch_vllm_moe_model_weight_loader
from verl.utils.vllm.vllm_fp8_utils import apply_vllm_fp8_patches, is_fp8_model, load_quanted_weights

logger = logging.getLogger(__file__)
logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "WARN"))

# magic numbers that ensure we are using the same LoRA adapter during the rollout and training process
VLLM_LORA_INT_ID = 123
VLLM_LORA_NAME = "123"
VLLM_LORA_PATH = "simon_lora_path"

VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS = {"VLLM_ALL2ALL_BACKEND": "flashinfer_all2allv", "VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_NZ": "0"}


def set_death_signal():
    """Kill the current process when the parent process exits."""
    if platform.system() != "Linux":
        return
    libc = ctypes.CDLL("libc.so.6")
    libc.prctl(1, signal.SIGKILL)
    if os.getppid() == 1:
        os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGKILL)


def get_device_uuid(device_id: int) -> str:
    from vllm.platforms import current_platform

    # Convert torch.npu.current_device to its corresponding ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
    if is_npu_available:
        if os.getenv("ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES") is not None:
            npu_visible_devices = os.environ["ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES"].split(",")
            assert device_id < len(npu_visible_devices), f"device_id {device_id} must less than {npu_visible_devices}"
            return "NPU-" + npu_visible_devices[device_id]
        else:
            return f"NPU-{device_id}"
    else:
        return current_platform.get_device_uuid(device_id)


def get_vllm_max_lora_rank(lora_rank: int):
    """
    For vLLM, automatically adjusts the `max_lora_rank` to the nearest allowed value.
    The allowed values are retrieved from vLLM's MaxLoRARanks type definition.
    """
    assert lora_rank > 0, f"lora_rank must be greater than 0, get {lora_rank}"

    try:
        from vllm.config.lora import MaxLoRARanks
    except Exception:
        # FIXME: migrate vllm version https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/config/lora.py#L25
        MaxLoRARanks = Literal[1, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 320, 512]

    vllm_max_lora_ranks = sorted(get_args(MaxLoRARanks))
    if lora_rank > vllm_max_lora_ranks[-1]:
        raise ValueError(f"lora_rank must be less than or equal to {vllm_max_lora_ranks[-1]}, but got {lora_rank}")

    for rank in vllm_max_lora_ranks:
        if lora_rank <= rank:
            return rank


# https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/13175
def monkey_patch_compute_logits(model, vocab_size: int):
    original_compute_logits = model.compute_logits

    def compute_logits(
        self,
        *args,
        **kwargs,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        logits = original_compute_logits(*args, **kwargs)
        logits[..., vocab_size:] = float("-inf")
        return logits

    model.compute_logits = MethodType(compute_logits, model)


class vLLMColocateWorkerExtension:
    """
    The class for vLLM's worker to inherit from, in the colocate setting.
    By defining an extension class, the code can work no matter what is
    the underlying worker class. This way, the code can be compatible
    with both vLLM V0 and V1.
    NOTE: we define this class in a separate module, and the main module
    should pass the full qualified name as `worker_extension_cls` argument.

    Feature support:
    1. LoRA
    2. Online FP8 quantization
    """

    def __new__(cls, **kwargs):
        set_death_signal()

        # 1. patch for Lora
        VLLMHijack.hijack()
        # 2. patch online fp8 quant
        if os.environ.get("VERL_VLLM_FP8_QUANT_ENABLED", "0") == "1":
            apply_vllm_fp8_patches()
        # 3. patch QAT (compressed-tensors NVFP4) for dynamic weight loading
        vllm_config = kwargs.get("vllm_config")
        quant_config = getattr(vllm_config, "quant_config", None) if vllm_config else None
        _is_qat_model = getattr(quant_config, "quant_format", None) == "nvfp4-pack-quantized"
        _is_modelopt_qat = type(quant_config).__name__ == "ModelOptNvFp4Config"
        if _is_qat_model:
            from verl.utils.qat import apply_qat_patches

            apply_qat_patches()
            logger.info("Applied QAT (compressed-tensors) patches in vLLM worker subprocess")
        elif _is_modelopt_qat:
            from verl.utils.modelopt import apply_modelopt_nvfp4_patches

            apply_modelopt_nvfp4_patches()
            logger.info("Applied ModelOpt NVFP4 patches in vLLM worker subprocess")

        # TODO: For ascend NPU, when the corresponding vllm-ascend version is upgraded to v0.13.0,
        # please remove the VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS variable replacement action.
        # This is only a fix for vllm version < v0.13.0.
        if is_npu_available:
            for k in VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS:
                if k not in os.environ:
                    os.environ[k] = VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS[k]

        instance = super().__new__(cls)
        instance._is_qat_model = _is_qat_model
        instance._is_modelopt_qat = _is_modelopt_qat
        return instance

    def _get_drafter_model(self):
        """Return the drafter's model object, or None if unavailable."""
        drafter = getattr(self.model_runner, "drafter", None)
        return drafter.model if drafter is not None and hasattr(drafter, "model") else None

    def _get_draft_model_config(self):
        """Return the draft model config from speculative_config, or None."""
        spec = self.model_runner.vllm_config.speculative_config
        return spec.draft_model_config if spec is not None and spec.draft_model_config is not None else None

    def _use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync(self):
        """Return whether the vLLM MTP drafter should receive actor weights."""
        spec = self.model_runner.vllm_config.speculative_config
        return spec is not None and spec.method == "mtp" and self._get_drafter_model() is not None

    def _iter_all_models(self):
        """Yield models that need weight updates.

        Only vLLM MTP drafter sync is supported for now. Independent non-MTP
        draft models are not compatible with actor weight loading through this path.
        """
        yield self.model_runner.model
        if self._use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync():
            yield self._get_drafter_model()

    def _iter_all_models_with_config(self):
        """Yield (model, model_config) for models that need post-processing."""
        yield self.model_runner.model, self.model_runner.vllm_config.model_config
        if self._use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync():
            draft_cfg = self._get_draft_model_config()
            if draft_cfg is not None:
                yield self._get_drafter_model(), draft_cfg

    def monkey_patch_model(self, vocab_size: int):
        for model in self._iter_all_models():
            # patch compute_logits to avoid sampling OOV token
            monkey_patch_compute_logits(model, vocab_size)
            # patch weight loader to support MoE model
            patch_vllm_moe_model_weight_loader(model)

    def update_weights_from_ipc(self, peft_config: dict = None, base_sync_done=False, use_shm: bool = False):
        """Update the weights of the rollout model."""
        from vllm.platforms import current_platform

        from verl.workers.rollout.vllm_rollout.bucketed_weight_transfer import BucketedWeightReceiver

        if current_platform.device_type == "npu" and self.device is None:
            self.device = torch.device(f"npu:{self.local_rank}")

        # In async mode, make sure the old lora is removed before adding the new one
        if peft_config and base_sync_done:
            self.remove_lora(VLLM_LORA_INT_ID)

        use_standard_weight_load = not (peft_config and base_sync_done) and not is_fp8_model(
            self.model_runner.vllm_config
        )

        if self._is_qat_model:
            # QAT (compressed-tensors): Prepare for weight loading BEFORE receiving any buckets
            from verl.utils.qat import prepare_qat_for_load_weights

            for model in self._iter_all_models():
                prepare_qat_for_load_weights(model, device=self.device)
            logger.info("QAT: prepare_qat_for_load_weights completed")
        elif self._is_modelopt_qat:
            from verl.utils.modelopt.vllm_modelopt_patch import prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload

            prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload(self.model_runner.model, device=self.device)
            logger.info("ModelOpt: prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload completed")
        elif use_standard_weight_load:
            # Re-apply here because async IPC weight sync can happen long after init and lose MoE weight_loader attrs.
            for model in self._iter_all_models():
                patch_vllm_moe_model_weight_loader(model)

        assert self.device is not None
        receiver = BucketedWeightReceiver(
            zmq_handle=self._get_zmq_handle(),
            device=self.device,
            use_shm=use_shm,
        )
        receiver.receive_weights(
            on_bucket_received=lambda weights: self._update_weights(
                weights, peft_config=peft_config, base_sync_done=base_sync_done
            )
        )

        if self._is_qat_model:
            # QAT (compressed-tensors): call process_weights_after_loading AFTER all buckets are received
            from verl.utils.qat import manual_process_weights_after_loading

            for model in self._iter_all_models():
                manual_process_weights_after_loading(model)
            logger.info("QAT: process_weights_after_loading completed")
        elif self._is_modelopt_qat:
            from verl.utils.modelopt.vllm_modelopt_patch import modelopt_process_weights_after_loading

            modelopt_process_weights_after_loading(self.model_runner.model)
            logger.info("ModelOpt QAT: process_weights_after_loading completed")
        elif use_standard_weight_load:
            # Some post-load transforms are non-idempotent; run once after all buckets.
            from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import process_weights_after_loading

            for model, model_config in self._iter_all_models_with_config():
                process_weights_after_loading(model, model_config, self.device)

    def _update_weights(self, weights: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]], peft_config: dict, base_sync_done: bool):
        if peft_config and base_sync_done:
            weights = dict(weights)
            lora_request = TensorLoRARequest(
                lora_name=VLLM_LORA_NAME,
                lora_int_id=VLLM_LORA_INT_ID,
                lora_path=VLLM_LORA_PATH,
                peft_config=peft_config,
                lora_tensors=weights,
            )
            self.add_lora(lora_request)
            logger.info(f"vLLM load weights, loaded_params: {len(weights)}")
        else:
            # Add the FP8 related logic here as sharding manager has been deprecated.
            # Check if FP8 quantization is enabled and apply appropriate weight loading
            if is_fp8_model(self.model_runner.vllm_config):
                logger.info(f"FP8 model detected (async): {self.model_runner.vllm_config.quant_config}")
                # Convert bf16 weights to fp8 format before loading
                loaded_params = load_quanted_weights(weights, self.model_runner)
                logger.info(f"FP8 weights loaded (async), loaded_params: {len(loaded_params)}")
                # Keep the draft model in sync when present.
                if self._use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync():
                    load_quanted_weights(weights, self.model_runner, is_drafter=True)
            else:
                logger.info("Loading standard weights (non-FP8, async)")
                for model in self._iter_all_models():
                    model.load_weights(weights)

    def _get_zmq_handle(self) -> str:
        """Get ZMQ handle for communication.
        Uses Ray job id + replica_rank + local_rank to form the handle so it
        matches the sender side regardless of CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES differences,
        avoids collisions when multiple replicas share the same node, and is
        unique per Ray job to avoid cross-job collisions on shared hosts. The
        job id is forwarded by the vLLMHttpServer actor as VERL_RAY_JOB_ID and
        inherited by this vLLM worker subprocess.
        """
        replica_rank = os.environ.get("VERL_REPLICA_RANK", "0")
        job_id = os.environ.get("VERL_RAY_JOB_ID", "0")
        return f"ipc:///tmp/rl-colocate-zmq-{job_id}-replica-{replica_rank}-rank-{self.local_rank}.sock"


class SuppressSignalInThread:
    def __enter__(self):
        self.original_signal = signal.signal

        def no_op_signal(sig, action):
            if threading.current_thread() is not threading.main_thread():
                print(f"Ignored signal {sig} in thread {threading.current_thread().name}")
                return
            return self.original_signal(sig, action)

        signal.signal = no_op_signal
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
        signal.signal = self.original_signal


def build_cli_args_from_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    """
    Convert a config dictionary to CLI arguments for vLLM server.

    Handles different value types appropriately:
    - None: skipped
    - bool True: adds '--key'
    - bool False: skipped
    - list: expands to '--key item1 item2 ...'
    - empty list: skipped (vLLM uses nargs="+" which requires at least one value)

113	    should pass the full qualified name as `worker_extension_cls` argument.
114	
115	    Feature support:
116	    1. LoRA
117	    2. Online FP8 quantization
118	    """
119	
120	    def __new__(cls, **kwargs):
121	        set_death_signal()
122	
123	        # 1. patch for Lora
124	        VLLMHijack.hijack()
125	        # 2. patch online fp8 quant
126	        if os.environ.get("VERL_VLLM_FP8_QUANT_ENABLED", "0") == "1":
127	            apply_vllm_fp8_patches()
128	        # 3. patch QAT (compressed-tensors NVFP4) for dynamic weight loading
129	        vllm_config = kwargs.get("vllm_config")
130	        quant_config = getattr(vllm_config, "quant_config", None) if vllm_config else None
131	        _is_qat_model = getattr(quant_config, "quant_format", None) == "nvfp4-pack-quantized"
132	        _is_modelopt_qat = type(quant_config).__name__ == "ModelOptNvFp4Config"
133	        if _is_qat_model:
134	            from verl.utils.qat import apply_qat_patches
135	
136	            apply_qat_patches()
137	            logger.info("Applied QAT (compressed-tensors) patches in vLLM worker subprocess")
138	        elif _is_modelopt_qat:
139	            from verl.utils.modelopt import apply_modelopt_nvfp4_patches
140	
141	            apply_modelopt_nvfp4_patches()
142	            logger.info("Applied ModelOpt NVFP4 patches in vLLM worker subprocess")
143	
144	        # TODO: For ascend NPU, when the corresponding vllm-ascend version is upgraded to v0.13.0,
145	        # please remove the VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS variable replacement action.
146	        # This is only a fix for vllm version < v0.13.0.
147	        if is_npu_available:
148	            for k in VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS:
149	                if k not in os.environ:
150	                    os.environ[k] = VLLM_ASCEND_REQUIRED_ENV_VARS[k]
151	
152	        instance = super().__new__(cls)
153	        instance._is_qat_model = _is_qat_model
154	        instance._is_modelopt_qat = _is_modelopt_qat
155	        return instance
156	
157	    def _get_drafter_model(self):
158	        """Return the drafter's model object, or None if unavailable."""
159	        drafter = getattr(self.model_runner, "drafter", None)
160	        return drafter.model if drafter is not None and hasattr(drafter, "model") else None
161	
162	    def _get_draft_model_config(self):
163	        """Return the draft model config from speculative_config, or None."""
164	        spec = self.model_runner.vllm_config.speculative_config
165	        return spec.draft_model_config if spec is not None and spec.draft_model_config is not None else None
166	
167	    def _use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync(self):
168	        """Return whether the vLLM MTP drafter should receive actor weights."""
169	        spec = self.model_runner.vllm_config.speculative_config
170	        return spec is not None and spec.method == "mtp" and self._get_drafter_model() is not None
171	
172	    def _iter_all_models(self):
173	        """Yield models that need weight updates.
174	
175	        Only vLLM MTP drafter sync is supported for now. Independent non-MTP
176	        draft models are not compatible with actor weight loading through this path.
177	        """
178	        yield self.model_runner.model
179	        if self._use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync():
180	            yield self._get_drafter_model()
181	
182	    def _iter_all_models_with_config(self):
183	        """Yield (model, model_config) for models that need post-processing."""
184	        yield self.model_runner.model, self.model_runner.vllm_config.model_config
185	        if self._use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync():
186	            draft_cfg = self._get_draft_model_config()
187	            if draft_cfg is not None:
188	                yield self._get_drafter_model(), draft_cfg
189	
190	    def monkey_patch_model(self, vocab_size: int):
191	        for model in self._iter_all_models():
192	            # patch compute_logits to avoid sampling OOV token
193	            monkey_patch_compute_logits(model, vocab_size)
194	            # patch weight loader to support MoE model
195	            patch_vllm_moe_model_weight_loader(model)
196	
197	    def update_weights_from_ipc(self, peft_config: dict = None, base_sync_done=False, use_shm: bool = False):
198	        """Update the weights of the rollout model."""
199	        from vllm.platforms import current_platform
200	
201	        from verl.workers.rollout.vllm_rollout.bucketed_weight_transfer import BucketedWeightReceiver
202	
203	        if current_platform.device_type == "npu" and self.device is None:
204	            self.device = torch.device(f"npu:{self.local_rank}")
205	
206	        # In async mode, make sure the old lora is removed before adding the new one
207	        if peft_config and base_sync_done:
208	            self.remove_lora(VLLM_LORA_INT_ID)
209	
210	        use_standard_weight_load = not (peft_config and base_sync_done) and not is_fp8_model(
211	            self.model_runner.vllm_config
212	        )
213	
214	        if self._is_qat_model:
215	            # QAT (compressed-tensors): Prepare for weight loading BEFORE receiving any buckets
216	            from verl.utils.qat import prepare_qat_for_load_weights
217	
218	            for model in self._iter_all_models():
219	                prepare_qat_for_load_weights(model, device=self.device)
220	            logger.info("QAT: prepare_qat_for_load_weights completed")
221	        elif self._is_modelopt_qat:
222	            from verl.utils.modelopt.vllm_modelopt_patch import prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload
223	
224	            prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload(self.model_runner.model, device=self.device)
225	            logger.info("ModelOpt: prepare_modelopt_for_weight_reload completed")
226	        elif use_standard_weight_load:
227	            # Re-apply here because async IPC weight sync can happen long after init and lose MoE weight_loader attrs.
228	            for model in self._iter_all_models():
229	                patch_vllm_moe_model_weight_loader(model)
230	
231	        assert self.device is not None
232	        receiver = BucketedWeightReceiver(
233	            zmq_handle=self._get_zmq_handle(),
234	            device=self.device,
235	            use_shm=use_shm,
236	        )
237	        receiver.receive_weights(
238	            on_bucket_received=lambda weights: self._update_weights(
239	                weights, peft_config=peft_config, base_sync_done=base_sync_done
240	            )
241	        )
242	
243	        if self._is_qat_model:
244	            # QAT (compressed-tensors): call process_weights_after_loading AFTER all buckets are received
245	            from verl.utils.qat import manual_process_weights_after_loading
246	
247	            for model in self._iter_all_models():
248	                manual_process_weights_after_loading(model)
249	            logger.info("QAT: process_weights_after_loading completed")
250	        elif self._is_modelopt_qat:
251	            from verl.utils.modelopt.vllm_modelopt_patch import modelopt_process_weights_after_loading
252	
253	            modelopt_process_weights_after_loading(self.model_runner.model)
254	            logger.info("ModelOpt QAT: process_weights_after_loading completed")
255	        elif use_standard_weight_load:
256	            # Some post-load transforms are non-idempotent; run once after all buckets.
257	            from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import process_weights_after_loading
258	
259	            for model, model_config in self._iter_all_models_with_config():
260	                process_weights_after_loading(model, model_config, self.device)
261	
262	    def _update_weights(self, weights: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]], peft_config: dict, base_sync_done: bool):
263	        if peft_config and base_sync_done:
264	            weights = dict(weights)
265	            lora_request = TensorLoRARequest(
266	                lora_name=VLLM_LORA_NAME,
267	                lora_int_id=VLLM_LORA_INT_ID,
268	                lora_path=VLLM_LORA_PATH,
269	                peft_config=peft_config,
270	                lora_tensors=weights,
271	            )
272	            self.add_lora(lora_request)
273	            logger.info(f"vLLM load weights, loaded_params: {len(weights)}")
274	        else:
275	            # Add the FP8 related logic here as sharding manager has been deprecated.
276	            # Check if FP8 quantization is enabled and apply appropriate weight loading
277	            if is_fp8_model(self.model_runner.vllm_config):
278	                logger.info(f"FP8 model detected (async): {self.model_runner.vllm_config.quant_config}")
279	                # Convert bf16 weights to fp8 format before loading
280	                loaded_params = load_quanted_weights(weights, self.model_runner)
281	                logger.info(f"FP8 weights loaded (async), loaded_params: {len(loaded_params)}")
282	                # Keep the draft model in sync when present.
283	                if self._use_mtp_drafter_weight_sync():
284	                    load_quanted_weights(weights, self.model_runner, is_drafter=True)
285	            else:
286	                logger.info("Loading standard weights (non-FP8, async)")
287	                for model in self._iter_all_models():
288	                    model.load_weights(weights)
289	
290	    def _get_zmq_handle(self) -> str:
291	        """Get ZMQ handle for communication.
292	        Uses Ray job id + replica_rank + local_rank to form the handle so it
293	        matches the sender side regardless of CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES differences,
294	        avoids collisions when multiple replicas share the same node, and is
295	        unique per Ray job to avoid cross-job collisions on shared hosts. The
296	        job id is forwarded by the vLLMHttpServer actor as VERL_RAY_JOB_ID and
297	        inherited by this vLLM worker subprocess.
298	        """
299	        replica_rank = os.environ.get("VERL_REPLICA_RANK", "0")
300	        job_id = os.environ.get("VERL_RAY_JOB_ID", "0")
301	        return f"ipc:///tmp/rl-colocate-zmq-{job_id}-replica-{replica_rank}-rank-{self.local_rank}.sock"

304	class SuppressSignalInThread:
305	    def __enter__(self):
306	        self.original_signal = signal.signal
307	
308	        def no_op_signal(sig, action):
309	            if threading.current_thread() is not threading.main_thread():
310	                print(f"Ignored signal {sig} in thread {threading.current_thread().name}")
311	                return
312	            return self.original_signal(sig, action)
313	
314	        signal.signal = no_op_signal
315	        return self
316	
317	    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
318	        signal.signal = self.original_signal

14	"""
15	Bucketed weight transfer via ZMQ + IPC (or shared memory fallback).
16	
17	Not recommended depending on vllm for this file.
18	"""
19	
20	import gc
21	import logging
22	import os
23	from multiprocessing import shared_memory
24	from typing import Callable, TypedDict
25	
26	import torch
27	import zmq
28	from torch.multiprocessing.reductions import reduce_tensor
29	
30	from verl.utils.device import get_device_id, get_device_name, get_torch_device
31	
32	logger = logging.getLogger(__file__)
33	logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "INFO"))
34	
35	
36	class TensorMetadata(TypedDict):
37	    name: str
38	    shape: torch.Size
39	    dtype: torch.dtype
40	    offset: int
41	    handle: tuple
42	
43	
44	# copy from https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/examples/offline_inference/rlhf_utils.py
45	def rebuild_ipc(handle: tuple[Callable, tuple], device_id: int | None = None) -> torch.Tensor:
46	    func, args = handle
47	    list_args = list(args)
48	    if device_id is not None:
49	        # the key is to change device id to the current device id
50	        # in case two processes have different CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
51	        list_args[6] = device_id
52	    buffer = func(*list_args)
53	    return buffer

56	def create_shared_memory(size: int, name: str):
57	    """Create shared memory for weight transfer. If already exists, attach to it."""
58	    try:
59	        shm = shared_memory.SharedMemory(name=name, create=True, size=size)
60	    except FileExistsError:
61	        shm = shared_memory.SharedMemory(name=name)
62	        assert shm.size >= size, f"Stale shm segment '{name}': expected {size} bytes, got {shm.size}"
63	    return shm
64	
65	
66	def rebuild_shared_memory(name: str, size: int, dtype=torch.uint8):
67	    """Rebuild tensor from shared memory."""
68	    shm = shared_memory.SharedMemory(name=name)
69	    tensor = torch.frombuffer(shm.buf[:size], dtype=dtype)
70	
71	    return tensor, shm
